label: Actually obtaining condition determining one represented fact
definition: DeterminesFact A a p f means p holds at the selected actual world a and, at every world accessible from a, p entails the truth of f. The actual-truth clause excludes a false condition that vacuously entails anything. This is informational modal determination, not a definition of causal production or explanatory adequacy.
note: Uses the existing PSRStrength.Arena and accessibility. NecessaryBase says every selected basis fact is true at actuality and every accessible world; EvidenceOnly says a condition cannot distinguish worlds agreeing on the whole selected truth vector, including arbitrary infinitary dependence. Those existing definitions supply the exact scope of RestrictionBoundary. A fixed constraint may restrict alternatives without producing any bearer. Actual metaphysical scope and adequate explanation remain separate open questions; attribution deferred.
